manifesto.label: ABOUT THE STUDIO
manifesto.headingPost: is not an accident. It is a decision.
manifesto.p1: Pars Studios is an independent creative media studio based in Irvine, CA, and also serving Istanbul. Led by beat production — and alongside recording, mixing and mastering — we craft film scores and title music, commercial music, music videos, and the editing and visual effects (FX) that go with them, all under one roof. We care about one thing: turning an idea into a work you feel in your chest and see on the screen. Rather than chasing trends, we make room for every artist to find their own voice — because what lasts over time is character, not imitation.
manifesto.p2: Every project — whether a track, a music video or a commercial — begins with intent long before the acoustics or the camera. We sit down with the artist first and talk, at length, about what the work wants to say and which emotion it carries; only then do we open a microphone or roll the camera. We don't like to rush, because a rush eventually bleeds into the recording and the edit, and the audience feels it. For us, waiting for the right moment is often worth more than the most expensive piece of gear.
manifesto.p3: Gear matters, but the ear and the eye matter far more. Here, equipment is a tool, never the hero; whether it's a mix, a color grade or an FX pass, the real work is making the right call at the right moment. In the end only one thing remains: the silence that fills the room when the piece plays, and that instant when everyone quietly agrees, “that's it.” That is exactly what we're after.

items.quote: They didn't try to bend the song into something else. They listened, then made it land. The mix moves like the track was always supposed to.
Five hours in and we still hadn't opened a mic. That's the part most studios skip. By the time we tracked, the take was already there.
Mastering came back transparent — no over-cooked loudness, no lost air. It sat next to the references like it belonged.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: One week is comfortable for mix and master sessions; one week is usually enough for tracking too. For longer projects we plan multi-day blocks together.
Yes — 50% upfront to lock the date, balance on the day. We send a single invoice; bank transfer or card both work.
Cancel 48 hours before the session and the deposit is fully refundable. Inside 48 hours we can reschedule once at no charge.

items.q: What should I bring to a tracking session?
items.a: Your instrument, charged headphones if you use IEMs, reference tracks, and the stems or scratch you've been working on. We supply mics, preamps and the headphone mix.

items.q: Do you take remote mixing or mastering work?
items.a: Yes. Send stems or a stereo file via Drive or WeTransfer with a short brief and 2–3 references. Revisions and final delivery are handled over email.
WAV 24-bit at session sample rate, plus a streaming-loud reference MP3. Stems and tagged masters on request. Everything stays archived for 12 months.

privacy.label: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.heading: Privacy policy.
privacy.intro: What we collect when you use studiospars.com, why we collect it, and who processes it on our behalf. We keep this short and plain; if anything is unclear, write to us.
privacy.contactLead: Questions or requests about your data:

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Pars Studios operates studiospars.com, a recording studio in Istanbul and California that sells beat licenses, mixing and mastering services and studio bookings. Pars Studios is the controller of the personal data described here.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: Account: your e-mail address, an optional display name and a password, which we store only as a hash. If you sign in with Google, we receive the e-mail address, name and profile picture that Google shares with us; we never see your Google password.
Orders: the items you buy, amounts, currency, invoice details and a Stripe payment reference. Card numbers are entered on Stripe's checkout page and never reach our servers.
Service orders: the audio files you upload for mixing or mastering, your notes and references, and the files we deliver back to you.
Bookings: the date, time, service type and any notes you add when reserving studio time.
Technical data: the IP address, browser and timestamps of requests, kept in server logs for security and debugging.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: To create and secure your account, deliver the licenses and files you purchase, run your bookings, and send transactional e-mails such as verification links, receipts and order status updates.
To prevent fraud and abuse, to keep accounting records the law requires, and to answer your messages.
We do not send marketing e-mails unless you ask for them, we do not run advertising trackers, and we never sell your data.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We set a session cookie and a CSRF cookie so that you stay signed in and forms cannot be forged. Both are essential and expire when your session ends or you sign out.
Your shopping cart is kept in your browser's local storage and is never sent to us until you check out.

sections.heading: Who processes data for us
paragraphs: Stripe for payments, Google for optional sign-in, Cloudflare R2 for file storage, Resend for e-mail delivery, and Vercel and Hetzner for hosting. Each processor only receives the data needed for its task and is bound by its own privacy terms.
Data may be processed in the European Union and the United States under the safeguards these providers offer.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Your account and order history stay until you ask us to delete them. Accounting records are kept for as long as tax law requires, even after account deletion.

Purchased downloads are available for the period stated in your license (30 days by default, extendable on request). Files uploaded for a service order and the deliverables we produce are kept while the order is open and for a limited period afterwards so revisions and re-downloads remain possible, then deleted.
Server logs are rotated and kept for no longer than 90 days.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask us at any time to access, correct, export or delete your personal data, or to object to a specific use. Where the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) applies, you have the rights those laws grant, including the right to complain to your local supervisory authority.
To exercise a right, e-mail us from the address on your account. We answer within 30 days.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: When this policy changes we update the effective date above and, for material changes, notify account holders by e-mail.
